maria: quick flag: p95 for /v1/generate (foo-prod) jumped after variant weight change. p50 46->55ms; p95 205->365ms; p99 710->715ms; samples 20k->9k
aj: likely sampling/tdigest merge effect; variant-A (low-latency) weight reduced to 0.1 at 2026-03-22T22:14Z
sam: dashboard shows only merged percentiles, no provenance. product confused why p95 moved but p99 didn't
jonathan: also saw quota.fallback spikes; some requests routed to slower pool
aj: proposals: 1) UI badge with samplecount & origin; 2) API param expand=variants returning per-variant pcts when requested; 3) tag quota-fallback and expose filter
maria: UX: tooltip explaining why p95 can shift w/out p99 change + auto-note on big percentile+sample deltas
sam: impl note: tdigest rollups need extra origin counters; keep compact default and expand opt-in
aj: owners: UI badge (maria), metrics API expand (sam), sample tagging (jonathan), alert prototype (aj)
console-bot: rollout r-2026-03-22-77 recorded at 22:14Z
maria: will mock and drop in #design tomorrow
